Metadata.title: Apercura
Metadata.description: The open directory and free booking tool for every health practitioner in France.
Metadata.proDescription: Apercura publishes a factual page for every health practitioner registered in France. Find yours and claim it for free.

specimen.heading: Every practitioner already has a page
specimen.intro: This is a page as the national register fills it, before the practitioner claims it: known fields are filled, the others say plainly that they are not provided.

free.title: Free

hostedInFrance.title: Health data hosted in France
hostedInFrance.description: Health data is hosted in France by an HDS-certified host ({host}) and encrypted at the application level.

encrypted.title: Encrypted data
encrypted.description: Patient data is encrypted at the application level. Host it yourself or with an HDS-certified host.

selfHostable.title: Self-hostable
selfHostable.description: Run the whole platform yourself with Docker, open data import included.

registry.heading: Built from the national register
registry.intro: Each page starts from the public register of health professionals. Nobody pays to be listed, and nobody is left out.
registry.sourceName: Annuaire Santé, Agence du numérique en santé

pro.heading: Are you a health practitioner?
pro.body: Your page already exists. Claiming it is free.

ProPage.title: Your page already exists.
ProPage.lead: Apercura publishes a factual page for every health practitioner registered in France, built from public data. Find yours, claim it for free and complete it.
ProPage.stepsHeading: Claiming your page, in three steps

find.title: Find your page
find.description: Search by name or RPPS number. The page is already filled with your public registry information.

verify.title: Prove it is you
verify.description: Sign in with Pro Santé Connect using your e-CPS, or send a document that a person reviews.

complete.title: Complete it and open booking
complete.description: Add your hours and practice details and, if you wish, free online booking. Patients book without creating an account.

ProPage.sampleHeading: What a page looks like before it is claimed
ProPage.sampleNote: Fictitious example: this practitioner does not exist.
ProPage.factsHeading: Factual, and the same for everyone
ProPage.facts: Pages carry factual information only, as French medical ethics require. There are no ratings, no ads and no paid ranking: every practitioner is listed the same way.

SearchPage.emptyBody: The directory is being imported from the national register. Search results will appear on this page soon.
